description.value: Mai's Cafe is a city-operated café run by Burnaby Hospitality (Food Burnaby), associated with Burnaby Village Museum and serving ice cream and sandwiches. It is part of a network of cafés spread across Burnaby's parks and recreational facilities, operated by the same municipal hospitality arm that manages golf clubs, restaurants, and event venues. Cyclists in the area will find it a compact quick-bite stop near a heritage museum site.
